title: Unified as One
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when Chen Ji's consciousness resonated with the Eternal Chess Game, a gaze that transcended time and space pierced through the Void—that was Cang Yutian's gaze, falling upon him for the very first time.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's fingertips touched that illusory light, a vast information flow as immense as the sea rushed into his Mental Sea. It was not cold data, but a Will Inheritance spanning countless ages—warm, profound, brimming with expectation. Countless scenes flickered before his eyes like a carousel: ancient stars falling, remnants of the immortal-demon wars, seven figures each occupying a corner of the chessboard... Each frame was crystal clear, as if within reach.

"Break it..." The voice rang out again, no longer a distant echo, but a whisper right at his ear. Chen Ji felt his soul being drawn by some force, as the membrane sealed within his Mental Sea for seventeen years slowly dissolved. He saw the true face of the seventh Chess Player—a face bearing seven-tenths resemblance to the portrait of the Ancestral Daoist in the Tianji Record, with eyes and brows radiating the composure of a master strategist.

dialogue.content: "Young Master, this old one has waited three hundred years for this day." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the first page of the Tianji Record and bowed deeply to the illusory figure. "The Seventh Chess Player—the Will Inheritance left by the Ancestral Daoist's seventh disciple, you have finally touched its threshold."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his vision go black as consciousness was forcibly dragged into a chaotic Void. There was no division between heaven and earth here, no passage of time, only endless chessboard patterns spreading in all directions. Upon the chessboard, seven points of light each shone brilliantly—he had seen the six rays of light, and now the seventh ray was slowly forming at his chest. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed through the Void, guiding him.

"The Seven Chess Players: Tian枢, Tian璇, Tian玑, Tian权, Yu衡, Kai阳, Yao光—seven ancient powerhouses each holding one star, jointly maintaining this Eternal Chess Game." Mo Xiansheng's phantom pointed to the six known points of light. "Now, the Tianji Record has chosen you as the inheritor of the seventh star. From this moment, you are no longer merely a piece on the board, but a Chess Player."

However, at this moment, a shocking truth poured into Chen Ji's Mental Sea along with the seventh ray of light. It concerned the origin of the ultimate Chess Player, Cang Yutian—he was not, as the rumors claimed, a born incarnation of the cosmic will, but the first sentient being to awaken countless epochs ago, accumulating experience through billions of years of reincarnation and scheming, finally achieving today's supreme status in the Dao of Chess.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian... was originally the first piece on this board." Mo Xiansheng's voice rarely carried a hint of reverence. "He used eternity as his game, all living beings as his pieces, and clawed his way from piece to Chess Player. Now, Young Master, your inheritance of the seventh star's power makes you the only one capable of playing against him in the Eternal Chess Game."

text.content: The fusion process was far more violent than Chen Ji had anticipated. The Seventh Chess Player's will was like a red-hot branding iron, reshaping the structure of his Mental Sea. He felt his thinking speed surge tenfold—wherever a chess game once required three days of calculation, now a single breath could penetrate all strategies. More importantly, he gained an unprecedented perspective: the Chess Player's viewpoint, observing the entire board from outside.

"This is... the complete picture of the Eternal Chess Game!" Chen Ji couldn't help but exclaim. Deep within his Mental Sea, a magnificent scroll was unfurling: the three major Sects were merely three small corners of the board, the Demonic Path invasion was another faction's move, and that Eye of Heavenly Dao—turned out to be a tool Cang Yutian used to monitor the chess game! Everything became crystal clear in this moment.

However, the growth in power also brought tremendous impact. Chen Ji felt the boundaries of his consciousness being constantly stretched—on one side, the memories and personality of thetrash杂役 servant Chen Ji, on the other, the experiences and obsessions of the Seventh Chess Player spanning countless ages. The two wills collided violently in his Mental Sea, causing splitting headaches. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, guiding him.

choice.prompt: The Seventh Chess Player's will is merging with you, the wisdom and experience of eternity rushing in—how will you choose?

choices.description: Completely open your divine consciousness, allowing the Seventh Chess Player's will to fully integrate into your soul, gaining the complete abilities of an ancient chess master. The cost is that Chen Ji's personality may be overwritten.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Complete Ancient Chess Master's Perspective and Abilities

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and made his decision. He no longer resisted, letting that vast will scour his Mental Sea. Memories of eternity flickered by—he saw the ancient immortal-demon wars, the birth of the first Chess Player, how Cang Yutian climbed step by step to the pinnacle of the Dao of Chess over countless years...

When the last wisp of memory integrated into his Mental Sea, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. In the depths of his pupils, stars were revolving, chess games were being calculated. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled with excitement: "Success! Young Master, you are now the true Seventh Chess Player!"

choices.description: Selectively absorb the core abilities of the Seventh Chess Player while preserving Chen Ji's personality and memories. This path is safer, but the growth in power will be limited.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Core Chess Mastery Abilities While Preserving Complete Personality
choices.risk_hint: May Be Unable to Handle Future Crises

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and began selectively accepting that will. He only took the core knowledge regarding chess strategy and foresight, leaving those overly heavy memories and emotions in the depths of his Mental Sea to slowly dissipate.

When the fusion completed, Chen Ji felt he was still himself, but his level of thinking had entirely changed. Those chess problems that had troubled him before were now child's play. A faint smile curved his lips, his eyes sparkling with unprecedented confidence.

choices.description: Maintain a parallel state with the Seventh Chess Player's will, both coexisting within the Mental Sea. This is the most dangerous choice, but may yield unexpected rewards.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Dual Perspectives and Independent Judgment Abilities

text.content: Chen Ji made a bold decision. He placed the Seventh Chess Player's will in an independent space deep within his Mental Sea, the two maintaining parallelism rather than fusion. In an instant, he felt two distinctly different modes of thinking coexisting in his mind.

This strange state made Chen Ji both delighted and worried. Delighted because he possessed two perspectives, worried because the divine consciousness load had almost reached its limit. Bearing the splitting headache, he murmured to himself: "This is an interesting experiment... Two of me—which one is the real Chen Ji?"

Regardless of which choice was made, the moment fusion completed, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented clarity. Within his Mental Sea appeared a complete chessboard—the Seven Star Positions each in their place, and at the center of the board, a blurry figure was slowly taking shape. That was Cang Yutian's projection—though merely an illusion, it already made Chen Ji feel immense pressure.

"Interesting..." A cold voice spoke within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, coming from that projection. "After countless ages, another new Chess Player has entered the game." The voice was flat, yet seemed to be passing judgment. Chen Ji felt a chill shoot from the soles of his feet straight to the crown of his head—was this the pressure of the ultimate Chess Player? A single projection alone already showed him the gap between life and death.

However, Chen Ji did not retreat. He stared directly at that projection, a faint smile curling his lips: "Cang Yutian? Chess Player of the Eternal Chess Game? I wonder—in this game of chess, which of us will have the last laugh." Mo Xiansheng watched from the side, dumbfounded—in countless ages, no more than three people had dared speak to Cang Yutian in such a manner.

The projection paused slightly, then let out a low laugh: "Interesting. You remind me of myself from long ago." His gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment. "But, boy, do you think acquiring the seventh star's power allows you to play against this one? On the chessboard, strength is supreme—and right now, you haven't even fully qualified to be a Chess Player."

Before the words finished, the projection dissolved like smoke. But Chen Ji knew this was merely Cang Yutian's probe across the infinite Void. The true confrontation still lay ahead. Yet at this moment, his heart held not a trace of fear. The fusion had brought not only increased power, but also a leap in realm—he had finally seen the path to the pinnacle of the Dao of Chess.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The chaotic Void in his Mental Sea had already dissipated, and he had returned to that crude Servants' Quarters. Yet everything around him now appeared different—the flow of Spiritual Energy in the air, the minute vibrations on the cobweb in the corner, even the sleep-talking of the disciple next door—all clearly transmitted to his perception. This was the Chess Player's perspective, macro and micro coexisting, overall situation and details equally controlled.

"Young Master, how do you feel now?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the first page, his expression carrying a mix of tension and anticipation. Chen Ji felt the surging power within his body, looked at his hands that seemed to have become deeper and more profound, and smiled faintly: "I feel very good. Extremely good." His voice was calm, but the light in his eyes burned more fiercely than ever.

The Tianji Record warmed slightly against Chen Ji's chest, and the originally incomplete seventh page was slowly repairing itself, countless mysterious Dao patterns moving across it like living things. He knew that from this moment, he was no longer that obscuretrash杂役trashtrash servant, but a true Chess Player in the Eternal Chess Game—though merely a newcomer to the game, so what? The path Cang Yutian walked over billions of years, he, Chen Ji, would one day complete as well.
